title: Vostane's Ultimatum
description: Finance Minister Vostane has booked the cabinet room directly, without going through Vyktor. She has projected the deficit forward. The number has moved. She is presenting conditions — stabilize within forty days, or she resigns and says why publicly.

title: Constitutional Draft — Fiscal Provisions
description: The fiscal governance articles are in final markup. Vostane's crisis makes these provisions more urgent. What the constitution says about budget process will determine whether future finance ministers have the leverage she's using right now.

title: Budget Allocation — Deficit Response
description: Vostane's numbers require a response. Either cut spending, raise revenue, or renegotiate with the IMA. Each option has a different constituency that will never forgive you.

title: Foreign Delegations — Response Required
description: Both embassies have now made formal requests. Vyktor says delaying further is itself a decision — one that communicates weakness to both powers. You need to choose which capital to visit.

title: Press Access — Formal Request
description: Nadia Voss has filed a formal request under the Public Information Act for budget process records. The legal deadline for response is fourteen days. Vyktor wants to discuss strategy before the lawyers draft anything.
